<analysis>legacy-web-lib 3.0.0 renamed LegacyRequestHelper.clientIp(..) to remoteClientIp(..). The script replaces the call in the files of the case.</analysis>
<script>
OLD = "LegacyRequestHelper.clientIp(request)"
NEW = "LegacyRequestHelper.remoteClientIp(request)"


def fix(p):
    done = set()
    for e in p.errors:
        path = e.get("file")
        if not path or path in done or not p.exists(path):
            continue
        done.add(path)
        n = p.replace(path, OLD, NEW)
        p.log(f"{path}: {n} call(s) renamed" if n else f"{path}: '{OLD}' not found")
</script>
